//: Template for the MCP servers this kit expects. They live in ~/.claude.json (NOT in ~/.claude/), so they are not installed by copying files — register them with `claude mcp add` (see README). Replace every <placeholder>; never commit a real URL, token or connection string.
//grafana: Grafana is NOT registered here: agents/ops-analyst.md defines grafana-staging and grafana-prod inline, so the servers exist only inside that agent. Run the Grafana MCP server in HTTP mode per environment (its own Grafana URL and service-account token live in that process's environment, never in this file) and serve them on http://localhost:8000/mcp (staging) and http://localhost:8001/mcp (prod), the URLs written in the agent front matter; another port means editing those two lines.
//databases: There is no database MCP server: database access is the CLI, scripts/db-ro.ps1 with targets from the local-only ~/.claude/db-targets.json (copy db-targets.example.json).
